source: NBC 2016 Part 8 (Building Services: Lighting & Ventilation) & ECBC 2017 Bioclimatic Design Guidelines
description: Configuration thresholds, feature definitions, and label generation parameters for the Vernacular ML Recommender.

features.name: temperature_mean
features.description: Annual or seasonal mean dry-bulb temperature in degrees Celsius.

features.name: temperature_max
features.description: Peak summer daily maximum temperature in degrees Celsius.

features.name: temperature_min
features.description: Winter daily minimum temperature in degrees Celsius.

features.name: diurnal_range
features.description: Difference between peak day and night temperatures in degrees Celsius.

features.name: wind_speed_max
features.description: Peak daily maximum wind speed in km/h.

features.name: solar_radiation
features.description: Daily shortwave solar radiation in MJ/m².

candidate_designs.name: Composite Jaali Haveli
strengths: Adapts to dual-season extremes (45°C summer, 5°C winter).
Stone jaali provides Venturi evaporative cooling and solar shading.
Internal courtyard facilitates nocturnal convective purge.

candidate_designs.name: Earthship Biotecture
strengths: Massive rammed-earth thermal battery buffers extreme diurnal temperature swings.
Passive solar south-facing glazing absorbs low winter sun.
Zero-energy earth tubes supply subterranean tempered air.

candidate_designs.name: Courtyard Haveli
strengths: Thick sandstone masonry delays peak daytime thermal crest.
Deep shaded colonnades shield habitable core from solar insolation.
Enclosed central aangan creates protected microclimate sink.

candidate_designs.name: Malay Kampung House
strengths: Elevated stilt platform catches higher boundary-layer air currents.
Louvered slatted envelope maximizes full-body sweat evaporation.
Broad overhanging thatch eaves deflect tropical monsoon deluges.

candidate_designs.name: Bamboo Longhouse
strengths: Porous woven bamboo partitions allow continuous cross-ventilation.
Ultra-low thermal mass cools instantly after sunset.
Raised platform protects occupants from surface pooling and moisture.

candidate_designs.name: Alpine Chalet
strengths: Steeply pitched gables cleanly shed heavy winter snow accumulations.
Interlocking solid timber logs minimize thermal bridging.
Compact volume-to-surface ratio minimizes radiative heat loss.

candidate_designs.name: New England Saltbox
strengths: Asymmetrical northern catslide roof diverts freezing winter gales.
Central massive masonry hearth anchors interior temperature.
South-facing apertures gather winter passive solar radiation.
